clauses.evidence: trace [cast]: 'ask may: [fire, skip] -> fire' then 'ask choose: [0, 1, 2]'; [cast | ask 1 -> skip]: no zone ask, nothing happens; [cast | ask 2 -> 1] / [-> 2]: the library-only and graveyard-only options; the opponent's-turn entry also triggers it (any entry). No Teferi on the probe board, so the find is not shown. Tree = OptionalEffect(Choose(both / library / graveyard)), SEARCH NAME_EQ 'Teferi, Timeless Voyager' to your HAND + REVEAL: identical to the canonical [B2b-named-card-search] shape apart from the selector mode. Packs: graveyard option finds Teferi into hand (PASS); library option finds Teferi into hand (PASS).
clauses.issue: engine-limit: the SEARCH selectors are ONE_OF (canonical CHOOSE); both are exactly-one QConst(1) picks, so a present Teferi is always found and the library search can never fail (CR 701.23b); BACKLOG 'Weaker than printed' records this for every tutor except Alpine Houndmaster. Weaker, not stronger. Note: REVEAL is the engine's recorded no-op over the top library card (verbs.py _look), not the found card; nothing moves and no view consumes it.
